description: Recommend the first AI agent (bot) a small business should set up, plus the next 3 jobs to add, from the same 5 questions and the same ranking as the free planner at whatshouldmybotdo.com/tools/what-should-my-bot-do. Read-only, no account, nothing is saved. Ask the user the 5 questions first; do not guess their answers. Returns titles, why it fits, estimated hours saved a week (estimates, not guarantees), schedule, and links to each guide and the full plan on the site.

ai_tool.description: Q4 "Which AI tool will run your bots?" One of: grok (Grok Bot), chatgpt (ChatGPT), claude (Claude), n8n (n8n). Default grok.

apps.description: Q3 "Which apps does your business already use?" Up to 12 of: gmail (Gmail / email), calendar (Google Calendar), slack (Slack), notion (Notion), sheets (Google Sheets / Excel), crm (CRM (HubSpot, GHL…)), x (X / Twitter), linkedin (LinkedIn), youtube (Instagram / TikTok / YouTube), postiz (Postiz / Buffer), shopify (Shopify), stripe (Stripe), quickbooks (QuickBooks / Xero), sms (SMS / WhatsApp), github (GitHub), followupboss (Follow Up Boss), pms (Practice management software), fieldservice (Job management (Jobber, Housecall Pro, ServiceTitan)), courses (Course platforms (Kajabi, Teachable…)). Empty list is fine.

business_type.description: Q1 "What kind of business do you run?" One of: solo-founder (Solo founder), agency-owner (Agency owner (marketing, web, AI)), realtor (Real estate agent / team), medical-office (Dental / medical office), creator (Creator / influencer), trades-owner (Trades & home services), consultant (Consultant / coach / freelancer), ecommerce (E-commerce / Shopify store owner), app-developer (Indie app developer / studio), local-business (Local business owner).

first_goal.description: Q5 "What do you want first?" One of: customers (Win more customers), never-miss (Never miss a customer message), admin (Get admin and invoices off my plate), inbox (Get my inbox under control), content (Post and publish consistently), bookings (Fill my calendar with bookings). Default customers.

time_drains.description: Q2 "What eats most of your week?" 1 or 2 of: email (Email & inbox), leads (Finding & following up leads), content (Creating content), scheduling (Scheduling & bookings), support (Customer support / calls), admin (Invoices & admin), research (Research), reporting (Reporting & metrics).
